lighting_shading.note: Soft, diffuse lighting creates gentle volume without harsh shadows.

value_contrast.note: High separation due to bright subject against mid-tone background.

color_palette.note: Vibrant red and orange pop against the cool blue background.

composition_hierarchy.note: Single, centrally placed object dominates the frame clearly.

shape_proportions.note: Thick, rounded forms create a friendly, toy-like appearance.

viewpoint_depth.note: Slight angle adds depth while keeping the object fully readable.

edges_linework.note: Clean edges defined by color and shading, not line art.

surface_finish.note: Smooth, plastic-like finish typical of stylized 3D mobile art.

rhythm_staging.note: Static and stable presentation focuses on the object's form.
